# National Science Teaching Association (NSTA)

> > NSTA provides science educators with case studies, clicker cases, and problem-based learning resources spanning biology, environmental science, genetics, and medical topics for undergraduate and K-12 teaching.

The National Science Teaching Association offers a comprehensive collection of case studies developed by educators like Alan Cheville, William Morgan, and Dean Fraga. These resources support inquiry-based learning across disciplines including evolutionary biology, environmental science, biotechnology, and public health.

## Key Topics

- Case studies and problem-based learning
- Clicker cases for active learning
- Undergraduate science education
- Biology and evolutionary biology
- Environmental science and climate change
- Genetics and Mendelian inheritance
- HIV/AIDS and public health
- Antibiotic resistance and microbiology
- Scientific argumentation and scientific method
- Fluorescence detection and spectroscopy
- Greenhouse gases and climate remediation
- Medical decision-making and ethics
- Biotechnology and tissue engineering
- Wildlife management and conservation

## Health and Medical Science Case Studies

- [Antibiotic Resistance](https://www.nsta.org/ncss-case-study/antibiotic-resistance): Microbiology case on MRSA and antibiotic resistance mechanisms
- [Closing the Gap](https://www.nsta.org/ncss-case-study/closing-gap): HIV/AIDS case study on antiretroviral therapy and foreign aid policy
- [AIDS and the Duesberg Phenomenon](https://www.nsta.org/ncss-case-study/aids-and-duesberg-phenomenon): Case on AIDS/HIV controversy and scientific argumentation with Duesberg
- [Not Just Another Day at the Beach](https://www.nsta.org/ncss-case-study/not-just-another-day-beach): Melanoma case study on cancer treatment and medical decision-making
- [I Can Quit Anytime I Want](https://www.nsta.org/ncss-case-study/i-can-quit-anytime-i-want): Clicker case on drug addiction, neurotransmission, and dopamine
- [Osteoporosis](https://www.nsta.org/ncss-case-study/osteoporosis): Physiology case on bone homeostasis and calcium metabolism
- [A Spill at Parsenn Bowl](https://www.nsta.org/ncss-case-study/spill-parsenn-bowl): Sports medicine case on knee injury and musculoskeletal anatomy

## Genetics and Biotechnology Case Studies

- [Not Exactly...](https://www.nsta.org/ncss-case-study/not-exactly): Genetics case study on cystic fibrosis and genetic counseling
- [Can a Genetic Disease Be Cured?](https://www.nsta.org/ncss-case-study/can-genetic-disease-be-cured): Muscular dystrophy case exploring FDA regulations and drug development
- [Certified Cultured Beef](https://www.nsta.org/ncss-case-study/certified-cultured-beef): Biotechnology case on in-vitro meat and tissue engineering ethics

## Environmental Science and Climate Case Studies

- [Global Climate Change: Impact and Remediation](https://www.nsta.org/ncss-case-study/global-climate-change-impact-and-remediation): Clicker case on climate change, greenhouse gases, and remediation
- [A Green Light for CFLs?](https://www.nsta.org/ncss-case-study/green-light-cfls): Environmental science case on life-cycle analysis of compact fluorescent lamps
- [Pesticides](https://www.nsta.org/ncss-case-study/pesticides): Environmental case with public hearing simulation on pesticide policy
- [An Electrical Storm on the Horizon](https://www.nsta.org/ncss-case-study/electrical-storm-horizon): Case study on fluorescence detection and water monitoring using photonics

## Evolution and Ecology Case Studies

- [When Wilma Met Fred](https://www.nsta.org/ncss-case-study/when-wilma-met-fred): Clicker case on human evolution and hominin species fossil study
- [I'm Looking Over a White-Striped Clover](https://www.nsta.org/ncss-case-study/im-looking-over-white-striped-clover): Evolution case on natural selection in white clover cyanogenesis
- [Exaggerated Traits and Breeding Success in Widowbirds](https://www.nsta.org/ncss-case-study/exaggerated-traits-and-breeding-success-widowbirds): Sexual selection case on widowbird breeding behavior and traits
- [A Deadly Passion](https://www.nsta.org/ncss-case-study/deadly-passion): Clicker case on sexual cannibalism in Australian redback spiders
- [Counting Sheep](https://www.nsta.org/ncss-case-study/counting-sheep): Wildlife management case on bighorn sheep and mountain lion predation

## Technology and Ethics Case Studies

- [To Test or Not to Test the Software](https://www.nsta.org/ncss-case-study/test-or-not-test-software): Computing ethics case on software testing and systems failure
